title: Avocado Cream for Men: A Simple 1-Minute Routine
ex: Yes, men can use avocado cream. How much to use, how to fit it around shaving, and a simple night and morning routine.
rt: Avocado Cream for Men: Simple Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado cream for men: a simple 1-minute night and morning routine, how much to use for oily or dry skin, and how to use it around shaving without irritation.
quick: Avocado cream works for men just as it does for women. Use a pea-sized amount at night on clean skin, less on oily areas, and wear sunscreen every morning. After shaving, wait 5 to 10 minutes and avoid any cuts or razor burn.
facts: Men's skin is often oilier and thicker
A pea-sized amount at night is enough
Daily sunscreen is essential with kojic acid
